name: Setlocenia
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Setlocenia is a British goddess whose name means She of the Long Life. Only one inscription names her, and no fuller story survives. The single record shows her as a deity of prosperity and longevity. She likely guarded a long and healthy life along with good fortune. The spare record limits what we can say of her. Setlocenia's name is her core legacy. In the small evidence we have, she stands for the hope of a long and fortunate life.
